title: Useless
text:
Useless. I purchased these to cover certain cans I have opened. I often don’t use the entire can of chicken broth, etc. I wanted a lid to fit over a standard sized can in the United States.

I received 3 small lids and 3 larger lids. The small lids were too small to fit a standard sized can. The larger lid was too large to fit a standard sized can. They don’t fit the purpose intended. Most cans are a standard size and these don’t fit that size.
